jamais.setupTitre: Never Have I Ever, couples edition
jamais.setupDesc: You each answer in turn, out loud and honestly. No forfeits: just the truth, and everything it sets off.
jamais.longueurTitre: How many questions are you playing?
jamais.palierTexte: You can stop here and see what it says about you two, or keep digging.
jamais.resultatsTitre: Who has the most to confess?
jamais.resultatsSous: Out of the {{total}} questions each of you answered.
jamais.phraseEgalite: A perfect tie: you both owned up to exactly as much as each other.
jamais.phrasePlus: {{nom}} ticked “I have” most often. Whether that's experience or honesty is tonight's debate.
jamais.phraseAnge: {{nom}} keeps the halo. Too wise or too discreet, you decide.
jamais.q1: Never have I ever wanted to kiss you from the very first look.
jamais.q2: Never have I ever reread a text ten times before sending it to you.
jamais.q3: Never have I ever asked a friend for advice before replying to you.
jamais.q4: Never have I ever taken a detour just for a chance to run into you.
jamais.q5: Never have I ever had sweaty hands before one of our first dates.
jamais.q6: Never have I ever pretended to know a movie or a band just to impress you.
jamais.q7: Never have I ever wanted to introduce you to my parents within the first week.
jamais.q8: Never have I ever kept a ticket, a photo or some little thing from our first date.
jamais.q9: Never have I ever said “I love you” first.
jamais.q10: Never have I ever known it was you long before I told you.
jamais.q11: Never have I ever secretly looked through your phone.
jamais.q12: Never have I ever stalked your ex on social media.
jamais.q13: Never have I ever kept an eye on what you were liking on social media.
jamais.q14: Never have I ever lied about the price of something I bought.
jamais.q15: Never have I ever hidden a purchase at the back of a closet or in the car.
jamais.q16: Never have I ever kept a secret you still don't know about.
jamais.q17: Never have I ever lied about how many exes I have.
jamais.q18: Never have I ever gone through your things looking for a gift before the big day.
jamais.q19: Never have I ever spoiled a surprise I was preparing for you.
jamais.q20: Never have I ever pretended not to see one of your messages so I could reply later.
jamais.q21: Never have I ever cheated on anyone.
jamais.q22: Never have I ever fantasized about someone else since we got together.
jamais.q23: Never have I ever had a naughty dream you weren't in.
jamais.q24: Never have I ever faked it in bed.
jamais.q25: Never have I ever found someone in your friend group charming.
jamais.q26: Never have I ever compared us to one of my old relationships.
jamais.q27: Never have I ever had doubts about us.
jamais.q28: Never have I ever cried because of you without telling you.
jamais.q29: Never have I ever been afraid of losing you.
jamais.q30: Never have I ever answered “me too” to an “I love you” on pure autopilot.
jamais.q31: Never have I ever made up an excuse to skip a meal at your parents' place.
jamais.q32: Never have I ever criticized your family in my head during a meal.
jamais.q33: Never have I ever told someone else about one of our fights.
jamais.q34: Never have I ever told my friends something intimate about us.
jamais.q35: Never have I ever used our relationship as an excuse to get out of a night out.
jamais.q36: Never have I ever envied another couple's relationship.
jamais.q37: Never have I ever laughed at you behind your back, kindly.
jamais.q38: Never have I ever repeated one of your lines to someone because it made me laugh too hard.
jamais.q39: Never have I ever been embarrassed by you in public.
jamais.q40: Never have I ever pretended to love one of your gifts.
jamais.q41: Never have I ever watched the next episode of our series without you.
jamais.q42: Never have I ever secretly eaten your share.
jamais.q43: Never have I ever picked from your plate after swearing I wasn't hungry.
jamais.q44: Never have I ever used your toothbrush.
jamais.q45: Never have I ever blamed someone else for a noise that came from me.
jamais.q46: Never have I ever put music on to cover an embarrassing noise.
jamais.q47: Never have I ever made a shower last longer just to get some peace.
jamais.q48: Never have I ever pretended to be asleep to avoid a conversation.
jamais.q49: Never have I ever pretended not to hear the alarm.
jamais.q50: Never have I ever left something lying around figuring you'd end up putting it away.
jamais.q51: Never have I ever left the dishes “to soak” so I wouldn't have to do them.
jamais.q52: Never have I ever stolen the whole duvet in the middle of the night.
jamais.q53: Never have I ever warmed my cold feet on you.
jamais.q54: Never have I ever promised to go to bed early and then scrolled for another hour.
jamais.q55: Never have I ever worn the same clothes three days in a row while swearing they were clean.
jamais.q56: Never have I ever forgotten, while already on the way, something you asked me to buy.
jamais.q57: Never have I ever said “I'll be there in five minutes” while still lounging at home.
jamais.q58: Never have I ever said “we're on our way” when neither of us was ready.
jamais.q59: Never have I ever picked the restaurant mostly thinking about what I wanted to eat.
jamais.q60: Never have I ever picked a movie knowing full well you'd fall asleep in front of it.
jamais.q61: Never have I ever sulked for over an hour about something tiny.
jamais.q62: Never have I ever slammed a door during a fight.
jamais.q63: Never have I ever gotten the last word by only pretending to agree.
jamais.q64: Never have I ever laughed during a fight at the worst possible moment.
jamais.q65: Never have I ever lied when answering “it's fine, everything's fine”.
jamais.q66: Never have I ever pretended to sulk to get cuddles.
jamais.q67: Never have I ever dug up an old story mid-fight when it was already settled.
jamais.q68: Never have I ever insisted on being right about a detail just to win.
jamais.q69: Never have I ever apologized without meaning a single word of it.
jamais.q70: Never have I ever waited for you to crack first before making up.
jamais.q71: Never have I ever smiled in the middle of the street thinking back to one of our memories.
jamais.q72: Never have I ever kept a piece of your clothing just because it smells like you.
jamais.q73: Never have I ever wanted to steal one of your clothes for good.
jamais.q74: Never have I ever taken a photo of you while you were sleeping.
jamais.q75: Never have I ever found one of your flaws adorable.
jamais.q76: Never have I ever thought “this is the one” watching you do something completely ordinary.
jamais.q77: Never have I ever preferred a couch night with you over a big party.
jamais.q78: Never have I ever wished we could stay in our pajamas a whole weekend.
jamais.q79: Never have I ever wished one of our evenings would never end.
jamais.q80: Never have I ever thanked sheer luck for making us meet.
jamais.q81: Never have I ever thought about our wedding before we ever talked about it.
jamais.q82: Never have I ever imagined our future kids' names.
jamais.q83: Never have I ever pictured our life ten years from now.
jamais.q84: Never have I ever wanted to drop everything for a road trip together.
jamais.q85: Never have I ever spotted a house or an apartment and thought “that one's for us”.
jamais.q86: Never have I ever thought I was way too lucky to have you.
jamais.q87: Never have I ever kissed someone on the first night.
jamais.q88: Never have I ever sent a naughty text to the wrong person.
jamais.q89: Never have I ever flirted with someone to get a favor or a discount.
jamais.q90: Never have I ever lied about my age.
jamais.q91: Never have I ever pretended to listen to a story from start to finish.
jamais.q92: Never have I ever exaggerated a story to make it more impressive.
jamais.q93: Never have I ever cheated at a game to win.
jamais.q94: Never have I ever lost on purpose to make someone happy.
jamais.q95: Never have I ever belted out a song while making up half the words.
jamais.q96: Never have I ever forgotten your birthday.
jamais.q97: Never have I ever had a fit of giggles with you at a really bad moment.
jamais.q98: Never have I ever wanted you at a truly inappropriate moment.
jamais.q99: Never have I ever made love anywhere other than a bed.
jamais.q100: Never have I ever wanted to cancel one of our dates at the last minute, out of pure laziness.
